# Skills live in `.agents/skills/`

Canonical Agent Skills are at [`.agents/skills/`](../../.agents/skills/).

GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Gemini CLI discover that path natively. Cursor and Claude Code use symlinks under `.cursor/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`.

This directory is intentionally empty of skill packages so Copilot does not list the same skill three times.
